title: BMX
description:
[h1]Ride it, grind it, land it.[/h1]
Bikes, boards and skates with real physics. Lean to steer, hit the ramps, grind any rail on any map, and chain tricks into combos. No content to mount.

[b]New in 1.2.0:[/b] auto ride, a free bike rental machine, no more flings off posts and bumps, brakes that hold on a hill, Air 180s and spine transfers, and the skateboard, skates, scooter and tandem finished.

[quote][b]Official server:[/b]  connect gmod.naliwajka.com:27015
[b]Bugs and ideas:[/b]  [url=https://github.com/StevenNaliwajka/gmod-bmx/issues]github.com/StevenNaliwajka/gmod-bmx/issues[/url]
[b]No GitHub account?[/b]  Post in the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/discussion/3814420080/587314210897205457/]Bug Reports[/url] thread here.[/quote]

[h2]Feature List[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]Ten bikes.[/b] The 20" BMX, a long and fast 24" Cruiser, a quick little 16" Mini, a geared Road Bike, a Fixie (skid stops, fakies, trackstands), an upright City Bike with a basket, a long-travel Downhill bike, a Tandem for two, a Unicycle and a Penny-Farthing.
[*][b]A skateboard, a kick scooter and inline skates.[/b] Push, ollie, flip, grind and manual on the board; hop, flip and grind on the scooter; stride and grind on the skates (equip them like a weapon).
[*][b]Four motor vehicles.[/b] An E-Bike with pedal assist, an E-Moto, a Dirt Bike with five gears and a clutch, and a Moped. Admins only, unless the server lets everyone have them.
[*][b]A real model for everything.[/b] Every vehicle is its own model, built in code: the BMX's welded frame and working chain, the Road Bike's drop bars, the City Bike's basket, the Dirt Bike's bodywork, the skateboard's trucks. Each one has a picture in the Q menu and the [b]/bike[/b] window.
[*][b]Spawn menu.[/b] Type [b]/bike[/b] in chat to pick a ride or a park piece. Works on servers without the Q menu.
[*][b]Bike rental.[/b] A free vending machine: press E, click a picture, ride. Maps can put them where players spawn, and admins can place more. A rental nobody rides goes back after two minutes.
[*][b]Auto ride.[/b] Press O and the bike rides itself with the trick bot's brain, on servers running BMX (Mode). Any ride key takes the bars back.
[*][b]Real handling.[/b] Lean to steer, pedal up ramps, suspension that soaks up landings, and a bike that lands flat off a ledge instead of see-sawing. Brakes hold you on a hill, and posts, kerbs and bumps stop the bike or let it ride over instead of flinging it.
[*][b]Grinds on any map.[/b] Crank grinds on rails and double pegs on ledges, with sparks. No map setup needed.
[*][b]Tricks.[/b] Wheelies, manuals, stoppies, bunny hops, flips, barrel rolls, 360s, tailwhips and barspins. On quarter pipes: Air 180s and spine transfers.
[*][b]Style poses.[/b] Superman, can-can, no-hander, X-up and more, stacked on any flip.
[*][b]Combos.[/b] Chain airs, grinds and manuals into one line, then land it for a multiplier.
[*][b]Scoring.[/b] On-screen trick callouts and combo points. Tricks on the Road Bike pay x1.5, and a friend on your pegs doubles them.
[*][b]Ride together.[/b] A friend can hop on the pegs of your BMX or Cruiser or take the back seat of the Tandem, and the City Bike has a child seat.
[*][b]Bike rack and lock.[/b] A rack that welds to a car and carries two bikes, and a lock that keeps your parked bike yours.
[*][b]Park pieces.[/b] 15 ramps, rails, ledges and quarter pipes in three sizes, with a snapping build tool.
[*][b]Replays.[/b] Press J to watch your last 30 seconds from four cameras, slow it down, and save it.
[*][b]Cameras.[/b] A cinematic camera (L) and a trick cam that pulls back in the air.
[*][b]Crashes.[/b] You ragdoll off as your own player model.
[*][b]Your bike, your colour.[/b] 14 paints, or pick any colour.
[*][b]The little things.[/b] A real bell (a horn on the motor vehicles), a full set of sounds for every vehicle, wind rush at speed, splashes in water, and standing or attack riding stances.
[*][b]Gamepad support[/b] and a settings menu under Options > BMX.
[/list]

[h2]Made for BMX[/h2]
[list]
[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3815470101]BMX (Mode)[/url], the gamemode: SKATE, Trick Attack and Combo Mambo, personal bests and a leaderboard, and the trick bot that powers auto ride.
[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3815469993]Petopia BMX Fall[/url], the map: gm_skatepark rebuilt with autumn light and a whole city around it, with rental machines where you spawn.
[/list]

[h2]Controls[/h2]
[table][tr][th]Key[/th][th]What it does[/th][/tr][tr][td]W / S[/td][td]Pedal / brake (in the air: flip)[/td][/tr][tr][td]A / D[/td][td]Lean to steer (in the air: roll)[/td][/tr][tr][td]SPACE[/td][td]Hold and release to hop[/td][/tr][tr][td]Right mouse[/td][td]Wheelie / manual (in the air, with A/D: spin)[/td][/tr][tr][td]Left mouse[/td][td]Stoppie (in the air, with A/D: tailwhip)[/td][/tr][tr][td]R[/td][td]Bell on the ground, always (in the air or a manual: barspin)[/td][/tr][tr][td]ALT[/td][td]Hold with W/S/A/D/SPACE for a style pose[/td][/tr][tr][td]SHIFT / CTRL[/td][td]Sprint / tuck (on the Dirt Bike, SHIFT is the clutch)[/td][/tr][tr][td]Bracket keys or mouse wheel[/td][td]Shift gear (Road Bike, Dirt Bike) or set the assist (E-Bike)[/td][/tr][tr][td]E[/td][td]Get on (at the back of a friend's bike: ride the pegs, or the Tandem's back seat)[/td][/tr][tr][td]O[/td][td]Auto ride on / off (needs BMX (Mode))[/td][/tr][tr][td]K / L / J[/td][td]Paint / cinematic cam / replay[/td][/tr][/table]
